fails.rule_text: What it describes as passing includes every way the requirements allow the user to get that result.
fails.words: Times the user is asked after code starts because of a decision no one made (R32): none.
fails.review_reason: R32 requires the user to be asked when something that is the user's to settle still blocks after code starts. A user's decision left unmade (S6's case) is a decision no one made, so M4 counts the question R32 requires against "none" and excludes a way the requirements allow the user to get the result.
